name: countdown
steps: Reset, switch to Auto and choose Launch.
Let the controller power the pad, vent, and open the clamps; capture the live countdown.
hud: A small rocket. A very big afternoon.
A whole launch, driven by sound graphs

Power blends machinery layers. Pressure changes the warning rhythm. The graph waits for clearance, counts down and finishes ignition before liftoff. Abort cancels the sequence; exhaust follows the rocket in 3D.
The graph counts three pulses, then waits one last second.
All clear. The countdown is starting.
Mission control handles power and clamps.
